title: ClanSettings
description: Clan-specific Claude Code settings. Merged on top of the global baseline by the agent-registry action.

clan.description: Clan identifier — must match the clan's GCP project name.

allow.description: Additional permissions added on top of the global baseline. Cannot remove global permissions.

SessionStart.description: Clan scripts run after session sync completes. Must exist under agent-registry/config/hooks/

PreToolUse.description: Clan pre-tool-use scripts. Must exist under agent-registry/config/hooks/

Commands.description: Clan slash command files. Must exist under agent-registry/config/commands/

script.description: Path to hook script relative to agent-registry/config/. Must end in .sh

matcher.description: Claude Code tool name pattern (e.g. Bash, Write|Edit).

script.description: Path to hook script relative to agent-registry/config/. Must end in .sh
